minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved all seven 150 Holmes Street lots with added conditions and continued most other hearings to June 16.
minutes.summary: Meeting by Zoom, the commission heard the Lake Shirley Improvement Corp annual report, issued three negative determinations, and approved the seven notices of intent for the 150 Holmes Street subdivision with conditions for rain garden maintenance and buffer demarcation. It also approved the 386 Sunset Lane retaining wall work with an abutter-notification condition and continued most other hearings to June 16. Member Carl Luck's term ended and he said goodbye.

public_comment.topic: Raised concern about parking and sight lines on Prospect Street for the dock access at 239 Prospect Street.
Lake Shirley association president said fall drawdown reached target, offered dam keeper figures, and noted Shirley Conservation involvement for the bridge work.
An abutter at 386 Sunset Lane asked about wall security, tree removal notice, and fence access.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission approved the first of seven 150 Holmes Street lots, with conditions for rain garden maintenance and buffer demarcation.
The commission approved the 386 Sunset Lane retaining wall work, with a condition that abutters be notified.
It issued negative determinations for the 239 Prospect Street dock gate and for garages at 313 Leominster Road and 45 Cobra Road.
It continued the 46 Pine Grove Road, 326 Highland and Flat Hill Road bridge hearings to June 16.
The agent was directed to tell the Lemons Road owner to file a notice of intent, and an update on Hollis Road was set for June 16.

why_it_matters: The Holmes Street subdivision depends on rain garden upkeep and marked buffers, which affect nearby wetlands and neighbors.
Continued hearings, including the Flat Hill Road bridge, stay open until June 16, so residents with an interest can still comment then.
watch_next: June 16: continued hearings for 46 Pine Grove Road, 326 Highland and the Flat Hill Road bridge
June 16: public update on the Hollis Road property

reconciliation.summary: The records agree on the three negative determinations, the Sunset Lane order and the Hollis Road advertisement, but they differ on several votes. The main difference is that ours records continuance votes (Pine Grove, Highland/Holman, Flat Hill) and only one of the seven PSG Realty lots, and gives the lawnmower reimbursement as 300 where the official minutes say 30.
